findings.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false, leaving dead feature-flag logic
findings.body: The new helper `enableSqlExpressions` computes `enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)` and then returns false on every code path (`if enabled { return false }; return false`). This makes the feature-flag evaluation and the intermediate variable dead code that looks like an inverted-condition bug to any reader. Since the intent is to hard-disable SQL expressions regardless of the flag, the function should just be `return false` with a comment (or the call site should be a plain unconditional error), and ideally the FlagSqlExpressions feature toggle should be removed or marked disabled to avoid operators thinking they can still turn the feature on.
